# Cybernetic Intern

> Concierge Security Engineer 2 at Arctic Wolf. GCIH and CEH Master. Incident response, detection and defensive security, plus the Cybernetic Intern blog.

Security writing by a named practitioner. Every factual claim carries an
inline citation to a primary source, and each post states what remains
unconfirmed rather than asserting it. Posts are static HTML and need no
JavaScript to read.
